title: Silver Prize at the 2025 Hallym University SW Capstone Design Competition
summary: Received the Silver Prize at the 2025 Spring Semester SW Capstone Design Competition at Hallym University.
content: I received the Silver Prize at the 2025 Spring Semester SW Capstone Design Competition held at Hallym University on June 5, 2025. It was a great opportunity to present our project and receive recognition for our work.
imageAlt: Boseong Kim holding the Silver Prize certificate and award board at the 2025 Hallym University SW Capstone Design Competition.

title: Paper presentation at the 2025 IPNT Conference
summary: Attended the 2025 IPNT Conference in Jeju from November 5–7 and presented our work on an LSTM-based AI-PDR system.
content: I presented “Development of an LSTM-Based AI-PDR System Utilizing Smartphone IMU,” a study on pedestrian dead reckoning using smartphone inertial sensor data and deep learning.
imageAlt: Boseong Kim presenting an AI-PDR paper at the podium during the 2025 IPNT Conference in Jeju.

title: New KCI paper on multi-band Wi-Fi radio map construction
summary: Our work on a high-speed multi-band Wi-Fi collector and radio map construction pipeline was published in the Journal of Positioning, Navigation, and Timing.
content: The paper presents a system that collects 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi RSSI measurements in parallel and connects the measurements to a PDR-based radio map construction pipeline.

title: New KCI paper on autonomous radio map construction
summary: Our study on autonomous exploration-based radio map construction using a mobile robot was published in the Journal of Positioning, Navigation, and Timing.
content: The study uses frontier-based autonomous exploration, SLAM, BLE RSSI collection, and waypoint navigation to reduce the manual effort required to build indoor positioning radio maps.
